items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Eddie Cole. Eddie Cole was the first band then. [INTERVIEWEE] I don't know. I don't know. I didn't know how I was heard of the same.

ctx.x: No, I didn't work in New York. I went there to visit my mother-in-law, my husband's mother. Mm-hmm. And, uh, came back and I went back to there. So when I left Love to Lisa, I went back there. That was the second time I went back there.
You said Horace Henderson was the first band? No. Eddie Cole. Eddie Cole was the first band then.
I don't know. I don't know. I didn't know how I was heard of the same. Mm-hmm.
